scope: Build hbf1 = 2431ccf9. scripts/qualify_hmi_gate_route.py with its compiler-scope, normal-lifecycle and lock-release gates: --profile classic-comfort (hmi_classic_import, desk-configured TP700 Comfort pair, 72/72 checks), --profile unified-comfort (hmi_external_tag_create, desk-configured MTP700 Unified Comfort pair, 49/49) and --profile unified-pc (hmi_external_tag_create, seeded WinCC Unified PC RT baseline, 49/49). Every apply's baseline and after compile name exactly the target HMI's scope (Classic HmiTarget, Unified owning device); each Host lifetime closes by EOF with Host exit 0, every bridgeWorkerExit verified with code 0 and no forced termination, and the owned TIA process (handle captured after tia_start) exited; after that exit a new TIA process opened the saved original read-write at the first attempt. The whole route (refusals, applies, replay, checkpoint restore, fresh reopen) ran as on 1 November.
limitations: Three profiles and their fixtures only; WinCC RT Advanced and KTP700 Basic PN are not covered.

Lock release is observed as an immediate read-write reopen by another TIA process, not by inspecting TIA's lock files; complete content preservation stays a V21 boundary (no Classic alarm composition, no Unified Screen.Export).
